title: Memory safety bugs fixed in Firefox ESR 140.12, Thunderbird ESR 140.12, Firefox 152 and Thunderbird 152
description: Memory safety bugs were fixed in Firefox ESR 140.12, Thunderbird ESR 140.12, Firefox 152, and Thunderbird 152. These bugs relate to improper handling of memory which can lead to security vulnerabilities. The advisory references Microsoft Support Lifecycle for software support information but does not provide specific details about the bugs or their impact.
